description: Avloppsreningsanläggningens utsläppspunkter (91/271/EEG) is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. This data package contains GIS layers with points representing the discharge points of the waste water treatment plant, which are part of data reported to the European Environment Agency under the Urban Waste Water Directive 91/271/EEC. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Waste water treatment plant discharge points (91/271/EEC)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
